content.value_statement: Strong creator content often remains limited to one post or channel. This skill creates paid amplification and rights-aware repurposing plans from approved assets.
actual_capabilities: Scores creator posts across organic performance, hook quality, message clarity, production quality, and calls to action.
Plans whitelisting, Spark Ads, brand boosting, and dark-post strategies.
Allocates a stated budget by content, objective, and platform.
Maps approved source assets into channel-specific formats and modifications.
Builds rights-tracked inventories, naming conventions, and expiration alerts.
Produces KPI targets, testing plans, and scale or pause rules.
limitations: Does not approve content for brand, claim, disclosure, or regulatory compliance.
Does not process audio or video; users must provide transcripts, captions, assets, or performance data.
Does not access advertising, analytics, CRM, or asset systems without an optional connector.
Performance forecasts remain estimates unless the user provides measured campaign data.

use_cases.title: Select Posts for Paid Reach
use_cases.description: Rank published creator posts, choose amplification methods, and allocate a fixed budget across platforms.

use_cases.title: Expand One Asset Across Channels
use_cases.description: Convert an approved creator video into planned assets for advertising, websites, email, and organic social.

use_cases.title: Control UGC Usage Rights
use_cases.description: Create an asset inventory with allowed uses, expiration dates, naming rules, and renewal priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use repurpose mode. Turn this approved creator video transcript into assets for Instagram, email, and our product page. List required edits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one approved source asset

prompt_templates.title: Choose Posts to Amplify
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode. Score these creator posts and recommend which to amplify with a [budget] budget across [platforms]. Label missing metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rights-Aware Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use repurpose mode. Inventory these assets and rights terms. Create format specifications, a 30-day distribution plan, and expiration alerts.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Optimization Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode with these measured metrics. Allocate [budget], define audiences, create tests, and set explicit KPI thresholds for scaling, pausing, and refreshing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced paid campaign planning with measured data

output_examples.input: Five approved TikTok posts, a $5,000 budget, and measured views and engagement rates.
output_examples.output: A five-post scorecard, three amplification tiers, platform and creator budget splits totaling $5,000, audience recommendations, and scale or pause thresholds.

output_examples.input: One approved 45-second creator video with paid, website, email, and organic rights for six months.
output_examples.output: A rights record, ten planned derivatives, channel-specific edit specifications, a 30-day schedule, naming guidance, and a six-month expiration alert.

best_practices: Provide measured performance data, campaign goals, platforms, budget, and source labels before requesting a paid plan.
Confirm usage rights and expiration dates before planning advertising, website, or email reuse.
Review estimates, platform setup steps, and disclosure requirements before campaign launch.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated metrics as measured results.
Do not repurpose assets with unknown or organic-only rights for paid or owned channels.
Do not use this skill as the final legal, disclosure, or brand approval gate.

faq.question: What content can this skill use?
faq.answer: It works with published, approved creator videos, posts, reviews, images, transcripts, captions, and related performance data.

faq.question: What is the difference between paid and repurpose modes?
faq.answer: Paid mode plans media amplification. Repurpose mode plans new formats, channel distribution, asset organization, and rights tracking.

faq.question: Does it launch advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It produces setup guidance, targeting, budgets, tests, and optimization rules for a user or connected workflow to execute.

faq.question: Can it verify content usage rights?
faq.answer: It records rights information supplied by the user or an optional connector. It asks for missing rights before recommending restricted reuse.

faq.question: Does it need live platform access?
faq.answer: No. Live connectors are optional. Users can provide exports or pasted metrics, and missing values are marked as estimates.

faq.question: Does it review FTC disclosures or marketing claims?
faq.answer: No. A separate compliance and content review must approve disclosures, claims, and brand alignment before amplification or repurposing.
